task: Create GitHub repository MorrisLawKernel and integrate as the core backend + frontend for GravelKing Pro music & video sound platform

create_repo.name: MorrisLawKernel
create_repo.description: Morris Law Kernel V3.5 - The moat technology for the best music and video sound application. Numba-accelerated adaptive mastering engine with stereo-linked sidechain, auto-threshold, bass-aware dynamics, and IntelligentMultiBandIsolator. Includes professional Streamlit frontend.

instructions.commit_message:
Morris Law Kernel V3.5 - Production Ready Moat Technology

- Full Numba accelerated adaptive mastering engine
- All 3 advanced features (Stereo-linked, Bass-aware, Auto-threshold)
- IntelligentMultiBandIsolator for fast stem/voice work
- Professional Streamlit frontend (app.py)
- Plugin-ready architecture + benchmarking tools
- Ready to power GravelKing Pro DAW and apps
instructions.integration_notes: After pushing, this repository becomes the core backend engine. Use MorrisLawKernel.process() for mastering and IntelligentMultiBandIsolator for fast stem/voice features. The included Streamlit app (app.py) provides an immediate professional frontend. Install with: pip install -e '.[accel]'
